notes.title: Talon's Blade Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Talon's Blade Patch 1.05

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue where magic point progress was not being saved properly, leading to it being reset when the game was loaded.
[*] Fixes an issue where combos would break when swapping targets or killing enemies despite the next attack occurring within the necessary time to continue the combo.
[*] Modifies the number of alchemical ingredients in each level.
[*] There is now a 50% chance enemies will not drop alchemical ingredients when killed.
[/list]

notes.title: Talon's Blade Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Talon's Blade Patch 1.03

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes issues where opening cutscene could get stuck on the first panel.
[*] Improves parry damage.
[*] Reduces health regen from wellness elixirs.
[*] Clicking on the stats in the weapon inventory now brings up a description of what each damage type does.
[*] Minor visual tweak to injured Rasnayan enemies.
[*] Fixes an issue where the magic indicator would turn red even if the demon's deal was rejected.
[/list]

Damage Type Info:

[b]Slashing[/b]
While an enemy has unbroken armor, slashing damage is done to the armor first. Once an enemy's armor breaks, slashing damage is done to the enemy's health.

[b]Pierce[/b]
Piercing damage ignores armor and deals damage directly to the health of an enemy.

[b]Bleed[/b]
For each additional combo attack, the bleed damage value increases. The longer you make your combos, the higher these damage numbers become.

[b]Poison[/b]
Poison damage is dealt directly to an enemy's health. The more poison damage that gets past an enemy's poison defense, the higher the chance the poison will activate, draining the target's stamina.

[b]Fire[/b]
Fire damage is dealt directly to an enemy's health. The more fire damage that gets past an enemy's fire defense, the higher the chance that an enemy is set on fire.

[b]Stamina[/b]
Stamina damage is dealt to an enemy's stamina.

[b]Impact[/b]
If an attack's impact damage exceeds the enemy's impact defense, the attack will stagger them.

notes.title: Talon's Blade Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Talon's Blade Patch 1.02

notes.title: 1.01 Full Release of Talon's Blade
notes.content:
[b]Big news! Talon's Blade has left early access! Thank you to everyone who has provided us with feedback and advice! We appreciate you so much and couldn't have done this without you. 
We will continue to support Talon's Blade with regular updates that squash any bugs or issues as they arise. Thank you all for your patience and support! Enjoy the game![/b]

Release Notes:
[list]
[*] Full campaign
[*] New Game Plus
[*] One-life challenge mode
[*] 3 endings
[*] 3 combat stances
[*] 13 combo activated spells
[*] 18 weapons and 18 armor sets
[*] 42 achievements
[*] Combat Improvements
[*] Overall System Polish
[/list]

notes.title: Talon's Blade Update 0.30.0
notes.content:
[b]0.30.0 patch notes[/b]
0.30.0 brings a whole new level and a continuation of Marcus's story. This content can be accessed by defeating the Jackal in the Occidan Vale. This update also improves numerous systems and adds some new ones to enjoy. Thank you so much for your patience as we worked on this update! We look forward to delivering more content and story in the next major update! (hopefully somewhat sooner)

[b]New Content[/b]:
[list]
[*] The Cybrus River Valley level
[*] New weapons and armor
[*] New quests and enemy types (keep an eye out for those automaton shrines)
[*] A new combat stance and move set for Marcus
[*] A new alchemical ingredient and potion 
[*] A fishing mini-game 
[*] New and improved Jackal fight (he's been dabbling in blood magic a little)
[*] New narrative cutscenes
[*] New lore, location, and character notes
[*] Demon now makes sure you always have at least three health potions when you respawn (isn't that kind of them)
[list]

[b]System Improves and Fixes[/b] (in no particular order):
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue where Marcus would get tired and swing slower after the 3rd attack in a combo
[*] Increases the brightness of the Occidan Vale to improve visibility
[*] Fixes an LOD issue on some armor sets that flickered when Marcus ran
[*] Improves camera so that Marcus can no longer see through walls in front of him, but you can still see through walls behind him
[*] Rebalances several enemies and bosses
[*] Fixes an issue where Marcus couldn't absorb the souls of the dead in the Occidan graveyard
[*] Tabs in the inventory menu and the settings menu can now be clicked with a mouse for easier navigation
[*] Adds a meter to indicate how long Marcus's blocks last
[*] Improves the attack alert system to be more noticeable and flashy
[*] Improves parrying so that it is more consistent and enemies are less likely to miss an attack leading to a waisted parry
[*] Fixes an issue where the whispering caverns didn't have the correct prompt to enter and exit
[*] Fixes a bug that causes Marcus's health and stamina bar to spawn over dialog text, soft-locking the system when interacting with Valens too quickly after loading into the village.
[*] Improves CPU usage when in combat allowing for better frame rates when fighting numerous enemies
[*] Fixes a bug where getting too far away from where an enemy spawned causes them to reset their health and armor
[*] Changes armor so that collecting souls or killing enemies immediately replenishes some armor. Armor no longer regens and depletes magic.
[*] Adds feature where alchemical items will have a small arrow pointing to them when the scan quest button is pressed making ingredient harvesting a little easier.
[*] Changes spear enemies block animation to be more readable
[*] Improved textures on bandit armor. Removes some of the mud so you can see the color of the enemy's armor. Also corrects the normal map direction
[*] Improves feedback when Marcus damages an enemy. When damaged, enemies will flash red (except for ghosts who are already red).
[*] Various other small bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Talon's Blade Patch 0.29.7
notes.content:
0.29.7 patch notes
0.29.7 improves various systems and prepares us for update 0.30.0, which will bring a whole new level to explore, new enemy types, a new combat stance, new alchemical potions, fishing, and more.

- Adds a combo counter
- Retimes blocking so that block times match better with block animations
- Adds the ability to attack without locking on
- Adds a feature where attacking near an enemy will automatically lock you on to them
- Overhauls the spell system, tying spell casting to combo length rather than specific combo patterns
- Larger combos cast more powerful variants of spells
- Modifies spells to make them more cohesive
- Attacking no longer locks out Marcus's movement
- Improved Tutorials 
- Moves the free dodge and jump button to A on Xbox controller
- Moved the quest scan button to Y
- Improves magic UI and soul collection readability
- Various minor UI fixes
- Fixes a bug where bosses would regain all of their health
- Fixes a bug where Marcus could get caught under the lift in level one if he was too close to a wall.
- Adds more potions and alchemy ingredients to level one
- Adds new quest reward to Forgotten Valor quest

notes.title: Talon's Blade Demo Upgrade 0.7
notes.content:
Talon's Blade Demo Upgrade 0.7

- This update brings the demo version in line with the released version of the first two levels of Talon's Blade. 
- The tutorial system has been completely overhauled to better player to more easily and naturally learn the systems of the game. 
- The combat has been balanced and polished and the levels have been tweaked for better navigability.
